name: Magical Dedication
body:
You have devoted some of your energies to improving the meager spellcasting you have gained.

Benefit(s): You change the 4-level spellcasting you possess, like those from a ranger or paladin, to be more potent and available earlier. Your caster level increases to your class level. The new progression table, for both prepared and spontaneous, is given below. This does not affect 6-level or 9-level spellcasting progression, nor does it work for 4-level casters with ‘arcanist-style’ spell progression.

For 0-level spells, you treat spells from the nearest 9-level or 6-level spellcasting class as your 0-level spell list.

For example, a paladin would gain a cleric’s orisons and a bloodrager would gain a magus’s cantrips. Your GM has final say on which class’s 0th-level spells you gain.

For levels marked with a ‘0’, you only gain spells of that level if you would gain them by having bonus spells from your spellcasting ability score.
